description: Trust Card: "who made this mod, and is it what it says?" One mod's record on its own platform, a fact to a line: author, who uploaded it (Nexus, and whether that is someone else than the author), where it lives, version, first published, last updated, deprecated (Thunderstore), the platform's own download and endorsement or rating numbers, and what the platform says about permissions. Facts only, each from the platform: ModWrench adds no score or verdict. Nexus needs a connected Nexus account and the game's Nexus domain as gameId; mod.io a connected account and its numeric game id; Thunderstore needs nothing and takes the full "Owner-ModName" as modId. Use when the user asks "who made this mod", "is this the real one" or "can I trust this mod".

gameId.description: Nexus: the game's domain, e.g. 'skyrimspecialedition'. mod.io: the game's numeric id. Not needed for Thunderstore.

modId.description: The mod's id there: Nexus's number, mod.io's number, or Thunderstore's full name "Owner-ModName".

platform.description: The platform the mod lives on.
